code.description: string; card. 1; Short code, unique within the register (for example a System code aligned to ATA iSpec 2200 where an equivalent exists, or a Type code such as BR).

definition.description: text; card. 1; Precise description of what the option includes and excludes.

parent.description: reg(parent register); card. 0..1; Upper-tier entry, for example System to System Group, Sub-system to System, Build Station to Major Unit, Design Sub-team to Design Team.

applies_to_scopes.description: reg(PRODUCT_SCOPE); card. 1..n*; For System entries (2F.11) and Major Unit and Build Station entries.

range.description: json; card. 0..1; {lower, lower_inclusive, upper, upper_inclusive, unit}, for range-based options. Null ends are open-ended.

is_catch_all.description: bool; card. 1; True for precisely defined catch-alls (Final Assembly, General Sub-system).

is_structural.description: bool; card. 1*; For System entries: true for the structural Systems (Airframe System Group). Their Sub-systems are Sub-structures (derived, not stored on the Sub-system entry).

is_bench.description: bool; card. 1*; For Build Station entries: true for the Bench Build Station of a Major Unit; false for aircraft Build Stations.

sequence_no.description: int; card. 1*; For Lifecycle Stage entries: 1 to 11, the order of the lifecycle.

in_current_scope.description: bool; card. 1*; For Lifecycle Stage entries: true for stages 4 to 6 (Initial System Design to Detailed Design), false for the others until the scope is expanded.

discipline_type.description: reg(DISC_TYPE); card. 1*; For Discipline entries: Sign-off team or Consideration only.

lifecycle_stage.description: reg(LCS); card. 1*; For review stage entries: the aligned Lifecycle Stage (A to 4, B to 5, C to 6).

replaced_by.description: reg(same register); card. 0..n; For split or merged options.

source.description: string; card. 1; Framework vN or Tailoring Record id.
